$ podkop device 2001:db8:1::50
# an IPv6 address in Only for devices of TV
exit 0
--- stdout
ℹ️ The rules for 2001:db8:1::50, in the order they are matched:
➖ Rule bank does not take it: only for 192.168.1.30
➖ Rule ads does not take it: only for 192.168.1.20
✅ Rule TV (tv) takes its connections to the lists of the rule that reach sing-box, those to the IPv6 subnets of the lists (the names of the lists get FakeIP IPv4 addresses only), as one of its devices: through its servers
➖ Rule pc does not take it: only for 192.168.3.0/24, 2001:db8:3::/64
➖ Rule lan does not take it: only for 192.168.2.0/24
❌ Rule bad takes no device: no item of "only for devices" is an address or a subnet
➡️ What no rule takes goes directly
